notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Bloodline Keeper's first ability by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Vampire creature token.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Grimgrin's ability by sacrificing the Vampire, untapping Necrotic Ooze and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
